caption_used: Sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under the 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations. The sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed, avg 0.03) begins at approximately 0.2 and declines steadily to near zero by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter. The sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted, avg 0.44) starts at 1.0 and decreases sharply, converging with the after-average-gate line near 0.15 by layer 10 before both stabilize. Notably, the after-average-gate configuration (green dash-dot, avg 0.33) consistently maintains higher sparsity than the after-gate line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with the two lines never intersecting after layer 5. The before-gate configuration demonstrates that pre-gating hidden states exhibit minimal sparsity throughout the network.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line chart illustrating the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across network layers under a 1e-2 threshold, comparing three distinct gating configurations. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” is linear and spans from 0 to approximately 22, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” is linear and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with major tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Three data series are plotted: a blue dashed line representing “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03,” which begins near 0.2 at layer 0, declines steadily to approximately 0.03 by layer 5, and remains nearly flat near zero through layer 22; an orange dotted line labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44,” which starts at 1.0 at layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.4 by layer 5, continues decreasing to approximately 0.15 by layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly between 0.15 and 0.4 through layer 22; and a green dash-dot line labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33,” which also begins at 1.0 at layer 0, declines steeply to about 0.2 by layer 5, then decreases more gradually to approximately 0.1 by layer 15, and exhibits minor fluctuations around 0.1 through layer 22. The green line remains consistently above the orange line from layer 5 onward, and the blue line remains significantly below both throughout the entire range. No intersections occur between the orange and green lines after layer 5.
raw_responses.Chinese:
This line chart illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across network layers under a 1e-2 threshold, comparing three distinct gating configurations: “before gate,” “after gate,” and “after average gate.” The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear scaling and tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The blue dashed line (“sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03”) begins at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, declines steadily to near 0.0 by layer 5, and remains nearly flat at that level through layer 23. The orange dotted line (“sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44”) starts at 1.0 at layer 0, drops sharply to approximately 0.3 by layer 5, continues decreasing to around 0.15 by layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly between 0.15 and 0.2 through layer 23. The green dash-dot line (“sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33”) also begins at 1.0 at layer 0, declines to approximately 0.3 by layer 5, continues to fall to about 0.15 by layer 10, and then remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations between 0.1 and 0.15 through layer 23. The green line remains consistently above the orange line for all layers beyond layer 5, and the blue line remains distinctly below both throughout the entire range.
